word_count_source: authoritative paired_study.csv word_count; cross-checked against validated A2
length_only_model: StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression(C=1, L2, liblinear, random_state=261015)
primary_transformer_aggregation: pool the five pair-disjoint outer-fold predictions within seed, then summarize five seed AUCs
fold_diagnostics: AUC for each seed x outer fold; sparse if either class has fewer than 20 observations
length_only_uncertainty: 2000 deterministic pair-cluster bootstrap draws for pooled OOF AUC; conditional on fixed folds and baseline specification
transformer_uncertainty: sample SD and range across five training seeds; fold results are diagnostics and are not independent replicates
